about: Organisations on the road (#1587, knowledge slice B; docs/knowledge-model-design.md §4) and what each one's members know. Written by hand from the lore: every entry is a placeholder for the owner to review. Members are listed on people (villages.ts Person.orgs). `honours` are deeds (encounters.ts) the organisation remembers: told to any one member, the whole organisation knows, and the Warden's standing with it rises. Any kind of organisation fits: `kind` is plain words, and the game reads only its secrecy and ranks.

facts.text: The [Heralds] carry what the Compact finds, and the Compact hears what the [Heralds] carry. Nobody signed anything, and nobody would admit it.
facts.source: WORLD.md § Alliances and political arrangements › The Goblin Compact's shadow network

facts.text: The book says the mere was sweet water once, and the salt came in with an age that ended. Under the Compact of Knowing I must read that to anyone who asks.
facts.source: src/artificer/villages.ts › The book says the mere was sweet water once

facts.text: Under the Accords every nation pays into the [Heralds]' road and no nation owns it. That is why the messages still get through when two of them are at war.
facts.source: WORLD.md § Alliances and political arrangements › The Vidde Accords

facts.text: The Dyprike is less a kingdom than holds that agree not to fight each other more than twice a generation. They have kept to it for a long time.
facts.source: WORLD.md § The Bergfolk — dwarves of the northern holds › agree not to fight each other more than twice a generation
